task.title: Install Ink Cartridges
task.shortdesc: There are four ink cartridges to install.

context.p: Use the illustrations as a guide for this procedure.

step.cmd: Turn the printer on and open the top of the printer to expose the ink cartridge tray.
step.stepresult: The ink tray automatically moves to the center of the printer.

step.cmd: Open the gate to the ink cartridge tray.
step.info: Notice that the ink cartridge tray indicates the proper ink color to install.

step.cmd: Unwrap the black ink cartridge and remove the protective tape.

info.note: Do not remove or touch the copper contacts on the ink cartridge. Touching these parts may adversely affect the performance of the printer.

step.cmd: Gently insert the black ink cartridge into the proper position until it snaps into place.
Repeat the steps for each of the ink cartridge positions.

taskbody.result: The cartridge tray contains the appropriate ink cartridges for each position.
